title: Hummingbird engine, animated
caption:
A heart that never seems to rest.

To survive cold nights, many hummingbirds drop into torpor, a deep energy-saving state where their body temperature and heart rate fall sharply.

Source: National Geographic, American Heart Association.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
